feed_title: Orthopaedic Gel Memory Foam Dog Bed, 24cm Deep, Large 91 x 69cm and XL 114 x 89cm, Washable Cover | PawLunova Ennerdale
descriptionHtml:
24cm deep. Gel memory foam. Nothing thin about it.

Ennerdale is a gel memory foam orthopaedic dog bed, 24cm deep, in Large (91 × 69 × 24cm) and XL (114 × 89 × 24cm). The cover is washable.

Most beds look tired inside two years and owners have quietly accepted it. The foam goes first. It stops springing back, sits lower each month, and eventually a heavy dog on it is on the floor.

At 24cm there is far more material to work through first. The gel runs through the memory foam rather than across the top of it.

What they get

  • 24cm of depth: More than twice the depth of our 10cm Buttermere mattress.
  • Gel memory foam: Memory foam that contours to them, with gel worked through it.
  • Two large sizes: 91 × 69cm for the Large and 114 × 89cm for the XL.
  • A washable cover: Removable and washable to the sewn-in care label.

Best for: Large and giant breeds, heavy dogs, and older dogs who like depth.

Why it is worth the money

£145 for the Large and £185 for the XL is a serious number, and depth is what it buys. Depth is also the first thing a cheaper bed cuts. The core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and across the 1825 nights it covers the Large is about 8p a night and the XL about 10p. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Being honest about the height. 24cm is a step up, not a step on, and a dog who has stopped hopping may need a night to accept it.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Large91 × 69 × 24
XL114 × 89 × 24

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Measure them against 91cm for the Large or 114cm for the XL.

What is the gel actually doing in the foam?

Worked through the memory foam core rather than sitting on top of it.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

24cm of gel memory foam that contours to them. What that means for your dog is a question for your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover is removable and washes to the sewn-in care label. The core is never soaked.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Choose their size and put 24cm between them and the floor.
